---
title: "Command-line operation"
output: html_document
---

This guide is for operators with a `ros.form.validation` repository checkout and a configured R environment.

The `tools/` scripts are repository tools; they are not included in the installed R package.

Install the development packages listed on the home page. Run these commands from the repository root.

The shell example uses a POSIX shell and `date`. Edit the input path before running it.

Set `ROS_REGISTRY_AUTHORIZATION` to the HTTP Authorization header for the separate
`ros-registries` account. For Basic Auth, its value is `Basic ` followed by the
base64 encoding of `ros-registries:<password>`. Keep the value out of source files
and shell history.

## Prepare reports from the command line

```sh
references="output/references-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H%M%SZ)"
Rscript tools/prepare-reference-snapshots.R \
  --code-lists https://ros.ultreia.io/references/code_lists/ \
  --registries https://ros.ultreia.io/references/registries/ \
  --output "$references"

batch="output/ros-validation-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H%M%SZ)"

Rscript tools/validation.R plan \
  --input /path/to/ros-input-data \
  --versions 3.3.0,4.0.0,4.1.0 \
  --references "$references" \
  --output "$batch"

Rscript tools/validation.R validate --plan "$batch"
Rscript tools/validation.R report --plan "$batch" --report-filename index.html
Rscript tools/validation.R build-publication --plan "$batch" \
  --comment "Text-cell boundaries trimmed before validation."
```

The preparation step verifies catalogue and CSV checksums, then copies only the
tables declared by the ROS models. The resulting snapshot covers all three versions.

Use `--country`, `--year` and `--gear` on the planning command to restrict inputs.

Text-cell boundaries are trimmed by readxl. Use `plan --trim-ws false` to preserve surrounding whitespace.

This reader choice is saved in the plan; changing it requires a new plan.

META content errors are warnings by default. Use `plan --meta-as-warnings false` to keep original severities.

Structure checks are unchanged. The saved policy appears in each form report; changing it requires a new plan.

To resume, set `batch` to the existing batch directory and start with `validate`; do not create a new plan.

Use `report --overwrite` to regenerate reports from saved results. Build into a new directory with `--output DIR`.

See [Validate a collection](validate-collection.html) for stage outputs and input organisation.

## Upload to ros.ultreia.io

This uploader targets the existing private ROS service. It is not a general-purpose deployment tool.

It requires `jsonlite`, `digest`, rsync and SSH access using the configured `ultreia` alias.

Its remote destination is `/var/www/html/ros/validation`. `--host` changes only the SSH alias, not this path.

The prepared folder must retain the default `aggregated_<batch>` name.

```sh
publication="$(dirname "$batch")/aggregated_$(basename "$batch")"
Rscript tools/validation.R publish --directory "$publication"
```

The uploader verifies the manifest and remote checksums, then updates the batch catalogue and landing page.

Aggregate titles use the publication time in UTC, shared by the manifest and catalogue entry.

The optional `--comment` on `build-publication` supplies the plain-text note displayed beside that batch.

Uploading the same batch replaces that publication. Other timestamped publications remain available.

Apache must already serve `index.html` as the directory default. Uploading does not configure the web server.

Open the printed URL with an authorised account and review the root aggregate and an individual form report.
